analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($162.85) vs SMA5/20/50($170.07/$198.69/$214.63): Below moving averages, confirming weak short-to-medium term trend.
· Significant distance below SMA100/200($212.14/$203.92): Deepening long-term downtrend.
· 52-week position (14.9%): Recovered from 52-week low($148.80) but still far below historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (30.8→24.9): Continuing into oversold territory, strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-3.2008→-4.1243): Bearish momentum persists, signaling a strengthening downtrend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $159.94): Approaching lower band, band width at 39.00% suggests potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance]
· Swing Support ($140.85): Close to 52-week low($148.80), a key support zone.
· Swing Resistance ($180.28): First resistance level for any short-term bounce.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Forming Lower High): Weakening signal, indicating potential for continued downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.84x): Below 5-day average, reducing confidence in current price action.
· Current Stage Diagnosis (Downtrend): Further downside likely due to persistent oversold RSI and widening MACD bearish divergence; maintain watch-and-see stance.
